item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 23/Jan/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting the coast of southern China will moderate gradually tomorrow. The weather will remain rather cool in the morning over the region. Daytime temperatures will rise. The monsoon is expected to be replaced by an easterly airstream gradually tomorrow. Under the influence of the fresh to strong easterly airstream, it will be cloudier and relatively humid over the coast of Guangdong early next week. The northeast monsoon will affect Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week.
